entities.name: Early Titicaca Basin Cultures: Chiripa and Wankarani
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The earliest complex societies around Lake Titicaca, including Chiripa (c. 1500 BCE) and Wankarani on the altiplano. These cultures developed raised-field (suka kollus) agriculture, camelid herding, and ceramic traditions that laid the foundation for the later Tiwanaku state.
